definitions: A form of temporary hair loss that usually happens after stress, a shock, or a traumatic event.
A common cause of temporary hair loss due to the premature entry of hair follicles into the resting phase (telogen) of the hair cycle.
examples: She was diagnosed with Telogen Effluvium after a period of intense stress.
Telogen Effluvium can be triggered by various factors, including childbirth and severe illness.
